import sys
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

VERSION_FILE = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")

def update_version(version: str):
    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = "[^"]+"', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
    VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)
    print(f"Updated version to {version} in {VERSION_FILE}")

def update_release_notes(version: str):
    content = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.read_text()
    
    # Find the "Latest Changes" section
    # It starts at "## Latest Changes" and ends at the first "## \d+\.\d+\.\d+"
    match = re.search(r"(## Latest Changes\n)(.*?)(?=\n## \d+\.\d+\.\d+|$)", content, re.DOTALL)
    if not match:
        print("Could not find 'Latest Changes' section in release notes")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    header = match.group(1)
    changes = match.group(2).strip()
    
    if not changes:
        print("No changes found in 'Latest Changes' section")
        # We still want to create the version header if we are releasing
    
    # Construct the new section
    new_section = f"{header}\n\n## {version}\n\n{changes}\n" if changes else f"{header}\n\n## {version}\n"
    
    # Replace the old section with the new one
    new_content = content[:match.start()] + new_section + content[match.end():]
    RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.write_text(new_content)
    print(f"Updated release notes with version {version}")

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python scripts/release.py <version>")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    version = sys.argv[1]
    
    update_version(version)
    update_release_notes(version)
    
    # Run the script to add the date
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"], check=True)
    print("Release preparation complete!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
